verifications.claim: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Every year, the world celebrates Earth Day... On April 22, 1970'; R3: 'Earth Day is celebrated on April 22nd'; R5: 'Earth Day is celebrated every year on April 22nd'; R6: 'Earth Day 2026 is Wednesday, April 22'; R7: 'Earth Day is an annual event on April 22'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state Earth Day is celebrated annually or every year on April 22.

verifications.claim: The 2026 Earth Day focuses on the theme "Our Power, Our Planet".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'The theme for Earth Day 2026 is “Our Power, Our Planet,”'; R6: 'In 2026, the theme is “Our Power, Our Planet.”'
verifications.reasoning: R5 and R6 directly state the 2026 Earth Day theme as 'Our Power, Our Planet'; R7 mentions it for 2025 but does not contradict.

verifications.claim: Earth Day originated in 1970 to protest pollution.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The first Earth Day... April 22, 1970... to raise public and government awareness of pollution'; R3: 'The first Earth Day event in 1970... concerned about problems such as pollution'; R5/R6/R7: 'The first Earth Day was... 1970'
verifications.reasoning: All confirm origin in 1970; R1 and R3 directly link to protesting/raising awareness of pollution and environmental issues via rallies and teach-ins.

verifications.claim: Earth Day is a global event in over 190 countries
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'celebrated by more than 180 countries'; R5: 'observed in over 190 countries'; R7: '1 billion people in more than 193 countries'
verifications.reasoning: R5 and R7 directly support 'over 190'; R1's 'more than 180' is consistent and not contradictory.
